# netactuate_sshkeys (Data Source)

Reads Sshkeys visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_sshkeys" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `sshkeys` (List of Object) List of SSH keys installed for the account (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sshkeys))

<a id="nestedatt--sshkeys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sshkeys`

Read-Only:

- `fingerprint` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `ssh_key` (String)
